lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: She came out and she wanted ta talk ta me and that and she asked me why I was so sad and then I told her why and then after that everybody else came out like Travis and his, his cousin and a friend and after a while I had ta get up and I went into Marie's room fer a little bit and then they came in and they asked me, they were feelin' bad for me.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Some good friend. Did, what did you tell ah Kayla when she asked ya what was wrong? Well, tell us what you told her that you remember.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That I was sorry for what I did and

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Didn't she ask ya what you meant? Did what? Did you tell her some parts of this?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Wa, did she ask you what you meant when you said you were sorry for what you did?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And I think you told her a little bit. Cuz, we talked ta Kayla. What did you tell her? If you remember.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you know about Steve and Marie having sex?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well, I heard that they were doing stuff.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where did ya hear that from?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That Steven was trying to come onto her.
